did.unittitle: John D. Rockefeller, Jr. family memorabilia

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. All inquiries to view memorabilia require advanced notice of at least two business days, and may necessitate notice of up to one week. Items are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection includes honors, degrees, commemorations, medals, memberships, portraits, posters, ephemera, and other objects pertaining to the life, philanthropy, and activities of John D. Rockefeller, Jr. and his family members, including but not limited to his spouses Abby Aldrich Rockefeller and Martha Baird Rockefeller.
